entities.name: Foundation and Expansion of Kongo
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Lukeni lua Nimi founds the Kongo Kingdom c.1390; capital at Mbanza Kongo; federation of provinces (Mbata, Soyo, Mpangu, Mbamba, Nsundi); agriculture, trade, and raffia cloth currency.
